value.rationale: The result exactly classifies primitive orbit populations and the labelled schedule distribution across every complete bipartite graph. The central natural invariant, an odd/even-position residue mod three, determines whether changing update order replaces two-cycles with three-cycles on any even-size graph having at least two vertices per shore, while odd total size forces four-cycles under every schedule. This supplies a structurally motivated schedule-selection mechanism, not a routine increment or arbitrary small parameter slice.
